title: Directed by Michael Bay
blurb: Something explodes, someone walks away without looking back, and the credit lands. The joke writes itself, and the format has outlasted almost every other caption meme because any real-life disaster can be retroactively awarded a two-hundred-million-dollar budget, three helicopters and a slow-motion pass. Bay's directorial signature is consistent enough that a single title card invokes the whole thing. Use it on car park incidents, kitchen fires, and any moment where somebody accidentally achieves cinema. No CGI required. No second take was ever necessary.
origin: The meme credit sting applied to explosive real-life moments.
